audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's Level Advantage Chart summary says 'Yours from level 1', but phases[0].side is Skill and phases[1]/[2] are Akali. The full layer also calls Akali 'him' and 'his' throughout while the content layer correctly says 'she'.
audit.why: Level 1 Akali has only Five Point Strike at 110 energy and no Twilight Shroud; Galio has Winds of War at 825 range but no engage. That is even, not 'yours'. Her lead starts at 2 with the shroud.
audit.corrected: Chart summary rewritten to match the recorded sides; pronouns corrected in the lines that were edited.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why ends with the boilerplate 'Reassess his ultimate too', phases[5].why claims Stormsurge/Riftmaker is your spike on a stage the chart gives to Akali, and phases[6].why says 'you are the best teamfight button in the game'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1, Shuriken Flip 16s, Perfect Execution 120s at rank 1, Hero's Entrance 180s. Those are the numbers that make a spike line actionable; none appeared anywhere.
audit.corrected: Each spike line now names the ability and the cooldown that owns the stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated interactions. (a) phases[0].why and breakdown.early say 'your passive shield already blanks his chip' — Galio's passive is Colossal Smash, an empowered area auto-attack, not a shield. (b) breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t say to 'R-isolate to lock her' inside Twilight Shroud, which is not a thing Hero's Entrance does. Meanwhile the interaction that actually decides the lane is never stated.
audit.why: Riot's Twilight Shroud text is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' — a targeting restriction. Winds of War is not targeted at a champion; it is fired to a location and leaves a tornado dealing damage over time, so it keeps damaging her inside the smoke even while she cannot be clicked. Justice Punch and the taunt DO need a selectable target, which is why they whiff into shroud. Riot also states Shuriken Flip marks 'the first enemy or smoke cloud hit' — she can mark her own Twilight Shroud and recast to dash back into it.
audit.corrected: Replaced the passive-shield claim and the R-isolate claim with the real split: ground-cast Winds of War burns through the smoke, targeted taunt and punch do not. Added the shroud-as-E-anchor escape.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere gives the tell for her burst opener.
audit.why: Assassin's Mark: 'Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.' The ring appearing on you is the cue, and her stepping out of it is the wind-up — not the ability cast.
audit.corrected: Ring tell written into the Level 5 spike text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Twilight Shroud as 'matchup-defining' with no duration.
audit.why: 20s at rank 1 falling to 16s at rank 5 is the whole rhythm of the lane, and Shuriken Flip's 16s is the second window.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[0] reads 'E-punch into his Twilight Shroud (it catches you mid-dash)'.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud has no displacement, slow or interrupt — it is smoke that hides her. The actual mistake is that Justice Punch needs a champion to collide with, so it flies through the smoke and lands you next to nothing.
audit.corrected: Mistake restated as dashing into an empty cloud.

audit.whatIsWrong: The loading tip ends '- Anti-heal if he sustains.'
audit.why: Akali's kit has no healing at all. This is filler on the one screen the player actually reads.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are where she's most dangerous: with E recast and full energy she can shuriken in, dash back out, and chunk you before your W reaches full ramp. The counter is timing — never start your W channel late, because a half-ramped Shield of Durand won't blunt a full-energy combo, and her Twilight Shroud breaks your targeting so the taunt finds nothing. Bait the shroud, wait it out, then commit your channel-into-taunt-into-E. At 6, stop trying to win the 1v1 outright: your Hero's Entrance is worth more on the map than in this lane, so ping a fight and drop in for a free taunt-knockup elsewhere.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are where she's most dangerous: with Shuriken Flip up every 16s and full energy she can flip in, dash back out, and chunk you before your W reaches full ramp. The counter is timing — never start your W channel late, because a half-ramped Shield of Durand won't blunt a full-energy combo, and Twilight Shroud blocks targeting so the taunt finds nothing. But the smoke only blocks selection: Winds of War is ground-cast and keeps burning her inside it, so poke the cloud, wait the 20s, then commit channel-into-taunt-into-E. At 6 your Hero's Entrance is worth more on the map than in this lane.
